 KETANKUMAR GOVINDBHAI SOLANKI  Versus  STATE OF GUJARAT ==========================================================
Appearance:
MR JITENDRA H NAVANI(13676) for the Applicant(s) No. 1,2,3,4,5 HCLS COMMITTEE(4998) for the Respondent(s) No. 2 MR. KARAN U VYAS(6992) for the Respondent(s) No. 2 MR CHINTAN DAVE, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1 ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP N. BHATT  Date : 18/09/2023

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ORAL ORDER 1.

By way of the present application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, the applicants pray for quashing and setting aside the impugned FIR being C.R.- 11209001210036 of 2021 registered with the Mahila Police Station, District : Sabarkantha for the offences punishable under Sections 498A and 114 of the IPC.
2. Respondent No.2 - complainant - Diptiben W/o.
Ketankumar Solanki is present before the Court and admits the correctness and genuineness of the affidavit filed by her through her learned advocate.
Learned advocate Mr.Vyas identifies respondent No.2 and confirms the correctness and genuineness of the affidavit filed by the complainant.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/9843/2021 ORDER DATED: 18/09/2023 undefined Ketankumar Govindbhai Solanki vs State Of Gujarat on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61717949/

sentences.text: 1 3. Rule.
Learned A.P.P. and learned advocate for the complainant waive service of notice of rule for respondent Nos.1 and 2, respectively.
Learned APP objects quashment of present proceedings on the premise of settlement.
4. With the consent of learned advocates, present application is taken up for final disposal today.
5. Learned advocate for the applicants has taken this Court through the factual matrix arising out of the present application.
6. At the outset, it is jointly submitted by the learned advocates for the respective parties that the parties have amicably resolved the dispute.

In support of such submission made at the bar by the learned advocates appearing for the respective parties, they have placed on record the affidavit of settlement of dispute duly signed by respondent No.2 - complainant.

7. Now, the dispute with reference to the impugned F.I.R. is settled and resolved by and between the parties, which is confirmed by the original complainant through his learned advocate, the trial would be futile and any further NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/9843/2021 ORDER DATED:
18/09/2023 undefined continuation of the proceedings would amount to abuse of process of law,
keeping in mind that the decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India has held this in case of Gian Singh versus State of Punjab reported in 2012 (10) SCC 303.

entities.text: Gian Singh versus State of Punjab reported in 2012 (10) SCC 303
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, the impugned F.I.R. is required to be quashed and set aside.
8. Resultantly, this application is allowed.

The impugned FIR being C.R.- 11209001210036 of 2021 registered with the Mahila Police Station, District : Sabarkantha and all other consequential proceedings arising out of said FIR are hereby quashed and set aside qua the applicants only.
9. Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
Direct service is permitted.
